legend: Surface-type compact osteoma with multiple fragments of tissue, showing both osteoclastic and osteoblastic activity.

This example shows the relationship to the adjacent bone and the architecture of the typical osteoma. Cellular detail is reduced by decalcification of this densely mineralized mass, but it can be appreciated in the other scan.
